body:
Discussed in the audio meeting.

The early return is uncontroversially appropriate.

As for changing the default: The issue description convinced us that this is worth breaking compat for, as it affects only a minority of users while solving a performance problem for everyone else.

Users will only be affected if two are true:
1. They actually use the feature (which appears to be rare, probably because the feature isn't super usable).
2. They have `area_mask` set to default (`==1`). Most people with actual setups will likely have it set to something else.

Even then, affected users (now likely down to a handful) can see the change in the changelog, and fix it by setting the `area_mask` to 1 on update.

Slating this fix for 4.7 as it addresses important issues.

Thanks to @goatchurchprime and Bippinbits for bringing this to our attention!

Code and rationale behind the changes look good to me.

I force-pushed a commit to rebase on top of `master` and improve the commit message to fit the style guide (no other changes made).

If merged in this cycle, this change should be mentioned in the 4.7 migration guide:

- https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs/pull/11959
